pages.title: Lanternfall
pages.creator: Bytepod
pages.description:
Lanternfall starts with a pirate ambush that sends you through a wormhole and leaves you stranded on Hearth III. Recover your ship and explore a galaxy of 30,000 stars in search of four keys that can relight your dying home star.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to fly, drive or walk. Press E to dock, land or interact when an option is available. Q scans or sets autopilot toward the next planet, while M opens the star map and hyperspace options.

pages.title: Cute Animals
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Cute Animals is a matching puzzle with a board of animal pieces. Tap and drag to line up at least three identical pieces and clear them. Check where a move can make a group before shifting a piece. When a match disappears, look at the new arrangement to find your next opening.

pages.title: Sudoku Classic – Daily Brain Puzzle
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Sudoku Classic – Daily Brain Puzzle gives you a Sudoku grid to complete by placing the missing numbers. Use each digit once in each row, column and box. Choose a difficulty from easy to expert, and use a hint if you reach a square you cannot resolve. The game saves your progress automatically so you can return to a puzzle later.

pages.title: Tank Strike Wasteland Rogue
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Tank Strike Wasteland Rogue puts you in command of a tank in a wasteland battlefield. Drive into enemy territory and destroy the forces defending each stronghold. Collect rewards as you clear encounters and move on to the next area. Watch where attacks are coming from as you decide which enemy to take on first.

pages.title: Save little red hood
pages.creator: Cannedfish Game
pages.description: Save little red hood combines match-three puzzles with gravity. Clear blocks to let stones fall, then Little Red Riding Hood can use those stones against the wolf. Look beneath each stone before you make a match. The pieces you remove determine where it can go. Use power-ups when you need help opening a path for the next stone.

pages.title: Car Crash Test: Abandoned City
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Car Crash Test: Abandoned City turns an empty city into a driving sandbox. Choose a vehicle, then use WASD to drive through the streets, try stunts and test how the car responds to crashes. Use Space to brake and Shift for nitro. You can repair the car with K or reset it with R when you want to try a different approach.

pages.title: Steal Brainrot Duel
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description:
Steal Brainrot Duel asks you to build a collection while defending it from raiders. Start with characters such as Noobini Pizzanini and grow your income to unlock rarer ones, including Tralalero Tralala. Raid other bases to add to your collection, and watch your own base while rivals try to steal from it.

Play solo or choose the two-player mode. Customize your avatar with accessories, outfits, wings and pets before heading back out.

pages.title: Sweet Haunt 2
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Sweet Haunt 2 asks you to guide a ghost through 50 puzzles, collecting all the candy before reaching the exit. Watch how the ghost carries what it picks up. A load that fits in the open can be too wide for the next passage. Plan the order of your pickups and use bombs to destroy carried objects that would otherwise leave you stuck.

pages.title: Color Block Jam 2
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Color Block Jam 2 asks you to slide colored blocks through matching gates. Look at which pieces are in the way before you move a block toward its exit. Clearing one can leave enough space to turn the next corner or reach a gate that was blocked. Work through the layouts by planning the order of your moves.

pages.title: Paris Kiss
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Paris Kiss is a puzzle about bringing two characters close enough to kiss. Pull and bend their stretchy limbs to move them into position. Look at how each arm or leg can reach before you tug it. The characters start in different poses and situations, so work out a new way to bring them together in each scene.

pages.title: Cityquest
pages.creator: Jogo | playgen.io
pages.description: Cityquest asks you to identify a hidden city. Make a guess and use the compass feedback to decide which direction to look next. Unlock clues such as the city's continent, flag, time zone or parts of its name. Compare the hints with what you learned from earlier guesses to narrow down the location.

pages.title: Jumping Fish: Ragdoll 3D
pages.creator: Nexus
pages.description: Jumping Fish: Ragdoll 3D challenges you to get a flopping fish through a series of obstacle courses. Adjust the power of a jump and time it to reach the next part of the route. A small hop may be enough for one obstacle, while the next calls for more distance. Reach checkpoints to open new areas.

pages.title: Bird Sort Challenges
pages.creator: HyHyGames
pages.description: Bird Sort Challenges gives you branches with birds of different colors perched on them. Move the birds so each group ends up together by color. Check how much space is left on a branch before moving a bird there. Leaving a free perch can give you room to separate the remaining groups.

pages.title: Obby Prison: Craft Escape
pages.creator: DarkPlay
pages.description: Obby Prison: Craft Escape sends you through a prison full of traps and guards. Find a route out by moving through the prison and keeping clear of the police. Look for security systems you can disable to open up your escape route. Check what lies ahead before leaving a safe spot, since the path can take you through guarded areas.

pages.title: IDLE Pet
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: IDLE Pet starts with a single cell and lets you build an animal from the inside out. Start with a dog and collect cells to develop its bones and organs. As one part grows, others open up, until skin and fur cover the body. Keep developing your creations across the game's eight animals.

pages.title: Gelatino
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Gelatino follows a character trying to stay frozen in the summer heat. Pick up ice along the road and watch for the hot suns that can melt him. Destroying those suns adds points, but getting close also puts him at risk. Decide when to go after the score and when to keep moving toward the ice.

pages.title: Fish Jam
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Fish Jam gives you a crowded beach full of fish trying to get free. Move the fish in an order that lets each one leave without another blocking its way. Free one to open space for the next, then check how the layout has changed. Later levels give you tighter arrangements to untangle.

pages.title: Egg Dash
pages.creator: GM Media
pages.description: Egg Dash sends an egg through an obstacle course in a rhythm-based platformer. Time your jumps to clear the hazards and keep moving through the level. Watch the gaps between obstacles as you go. Getting through one jump puts you in position for the next, so pay attention to the rhythm of the course.

pages.title: Stickman Football
pages.creator: Vkusnyatina-Team
pages.description: Stickman Football puts you in a one-on-one soccer match. Try to get the ball past your opponent and into the goal. After a shot, you can teleport to the ball and continue the play from its new position. Time the teleport for a chance to follow up when the first shot leaves the ball in a useful spot.

pages.title: Find The Truth Master
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Find The Truth Master presents a series of short puzzles with solutions that can go against the obvious choice. Look at the scene and tap or click to try the action you think will solve it. If the usual approach does not fit, reconsider what the puzzle is asking and look for another way to interact.

pages.title: Cozy Merge
pages.creator: Massive Core
pages.description: Cozy Merge gives you a board of numbered tiles and a goal of one million points. Put two tiles with the same value together to create one worth twice as much. Keep arranging tiles to set up your next merge. If you get stuck, use boosters to undo a move, shuffle the board or double a tile.

pages.title: Jelly Quest Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Jelly Quest Mania asks you to collect jellies by making matches of three or more of the same kind. Check what the level asks you to gather before making a move. A match clears pieces and changes what is available on the board. Complete the objectives before the level's time or moves run out.

pages.title: 11 Kisses
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: 11 Kisses follows an angel trying to reach the demon boy and break his enchantment with a kiss. Solve puzzles to get across the terrain between them. Use bridges and ladders to open a route, and set off bombs when they block the passage. Work out which obstacle to deal with first so she can reach him.

pages.title: Save Your Home
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Save Your Home combines idle upgrades with defense. Set up wires to block approaching enemies and improve your weapons to deal with the attackers. Your goal is to protect the house and the family inside it. Pay attention to where enemies get through and strengthen that part of the defense before the next attack.

pages.title: Death Race Monster Arena
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Death Race Monster Arena lets you choose a monster truck for derby battles, races or free driving. Pick a mode depending on whether you want to fight in an arena, chase the finish or explore. Earn coins and gold to buy more trucks. Play alone or use the two-player option to share the event with a friend.

pages.title: Vortex 9
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Vortex 9 puts you in battles with cat people and talking robots. Choose a fighter and take a weapon into combat, from a battle lollipop to a gun. Use what you bring to deal with the enemies you meet. Try a different character or weapon when you want to change your approach to the next fight.

pages.title: The Smurfs Skate Rush
pages.creator: IMPS
pages.description:
The Smurfs Skate Rush sends you down a lane-based course on a skateboard. Steer around rocks, logs and cars, jump gates and use rails or car tops for tricks. Collect strawberries to unlock more skateboards.

Special pickups open more characters, including Papa Smurf's red hat and Handy's pencils. Look for the magic portal as you skate so you can reach the next level.

pages.title: Blocku Golf 2
pages.creator: Vally Games
pages.description: Blocku Golf 2 gives you five shots to get a red ball into the hole. Pull back with the mouse or touch controls to set the direction and power, then release to send it across the course. Moving platforms, gaps, saws and TNT can get in the way. Choose a landing that leaves a useful next shot if you cannot reach the hole in one.

pages.title: Friday Night Funki Big Brother
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Friday Night Funki Big Brother gives you songs to play with characters including Big Brother and Boyfriend. Watch the rhythm prompts and press the matching buttons at the right moment. Each accurate response adds to your points. Pay attention as the notes get closer together, and try to keep your timing through the whole song.

pages.title: Baby Survival Challenge
pages.creator: goolgames
pages.description: Baby Survival Challenge puts you in a series of elimination rounds with a horror theme. Get through each short challenge to stay in the contest while other contestants drop out. The prize in the piggy bank grows after a round. The challenges get harder as you progress, and surviving the last one is the way to claim the accumulated reward.

pages.title: 2 Player Police Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: 2 Player Police Racing puts you in a race through city streets. Drive a police car and try to reach the finish before your opponents. Keep your speed up where the route is clear and leave room to steer at the next turn. The objective is to get across the finish line ahead of the field.

pages.title: Temple Raider
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Temple Raider sends you running through jungle ruins with an ancient guardian on your heels. Jump over spikes, slide under falling logs and collect coins, idols and treasures as you go. Watch the path before going after a pickup, since a trap may be in the way. Unlock characters and power-ups as you try to make a longer run.

pages.title: Emoji Link
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description: Emoji Link asks you to find identical emoji tiles and connect them with a line. Look for a route between the pair before selecting them. Clearing one match can make it easier to reach tiles that were blocked by the old layout. The game has no timer, so take time to find a path.

pages.title: Kill The Monster
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Kill The Monster sends a runner down obstacle courses where you collect coins on the way to a monster fight. Move past hazards such as swinging axes and saws while gathering what you can. Use coins to get speed boosts as you progress. Keep an eye on the path ahead so you can reach the end of the run.

pages.title: Fruit War
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Fruit War is a platform race between fruit characters. Run toward the finish and keep clear of the cutting obstacles along the course. Time your movements so you can get past a hazard without giving up too much ground. Get across the line ahead of the other fruits to take first place.

pages.title: Destroy the Village
pages.creator: gametornado
pages.description: Destroy the Village has you steer rockets through walls, vehicles and mechanisms to hit the enemy villagers. Choose a path that gets the rocket past the obstacles before it runs out of fuel. There are four rocket types with different speed, fuel and power. Use those differences to work through 24 levels, including four boss stages.

pages.title: MATH PLASTICINE
pages.creator: nau.kids
pages.description: MATH PLASTICINE gives you practice with quantities, addition and subtraction. Look at the prompt, then count the items or work out how many remain after the operation. Select the answer that fits. The activities move between recognizing a quantity and using those numbers in a calculation.

pages.title: Shot Color Bubbles
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Shot Color Bubbles asks you to shoot falling bubbles with a ball of the same color. Use the trail behind each bubble to identify its color. The meter in the lower right tracks when your own ball will change, so check it before firing. Three misses end the run. Choose shots that match the color you have now.

pages.title: Funny Puppy Dressup
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Puppy Dressup lets you choose clothes and accessories for a puppy. Try hats, shoes, pants and hairstyles to put together the look you want. Play the mini-games to unlock more outfits, then return to the wardrobe to use what you earned. Change one item at a time or give the puppy a whole new style.

pages.title: Evasive Balls
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Evasive Balls has you control two balls that move around an invisible circle. Tap to reverse their direction whenever an obstacle blocks the path. Watch both balls before you tap, since the change affects them at the same time. Collect the rings along the way and try to raise your score without hitting a hazard.

pages.title: Funny Throat Surgery 2
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Throat Surgery 2 has you care for a character with a sore throat and dental problems. Work through the game's clinic activities by cleaning her teeth, clearing germs and treating the polyps that affect her voice. After the appointment, switch to the dress-up stage and choose an outfit to finish the game.

pages.title: alien escape
pages.creator: idefixe
pages.description: In alien escape, a stranded alien needs your help to open the doors of a spaceship. Move the battery to its receiver so it can power the exit. Look at the layout before moving the battery, especially if the way to the receiver has several turns. Open the door to get the alien out of the level.

pages.title: Rush Race
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Rush Race is a driving game about getting past other cars at speed. Overtake traffic when there is enough room and steer clear of collisions as you continue along the road. Choose from different car models and see how the drive feels in each one. Watch the traffic before committing to a pass.

pages.title: Puzzle Pieces
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Puzzle Pieces gives you a central circle and several empty circles around it. Move segments from the center to the outer circles to fill them and remove them from the board. The goals change across six modes: one may ask for multicolored circles, while another asks you to beat the timer or reach a score. There are 60 levels to explore.

pages.title: Adam And Eve Night - do not use
pages.creator: Agame

pages.title: Sky Fly
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Sky Fly puts you in an F117 facing waves of aircraft. Fly through enemy fire and shoot down the planes you encounter. Pick up ammunition, fuel and hearts to keep the flight going. Watch for a safe route to each pickup as you try to stay in the air for as long as possible.

pages.title: The Sounds
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: The Sounds lets you explore the noises that different things make. Click the button for a sound and listen to what plays. Try the other buttons and compare what you hear as you go. The activity gives you a way to connect different sounds with the things that make them.

pages.title: Carrom 2 Player
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Carrom 2 Player is a board game about striking pieces into pockets. Aim the striker with the mouse and send it toward the pieces you want to move. A direct shot can be useful when the pocket is open, while a rebound can reach around other pieces. Judge the angle before you release the shot.

pages.title: Limo City Drive 2020
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Limo City Drive 2020 puts you in charge of picking up passengers and taking them to their destinations. Drive the limousine through city traffic or over off-road routes, then stop where the passenger needs to get out. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive and Space to brake. Give yourself room to turn the long car.

pages.title: Tow Trucks Coloring
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Tow Trucks Coloring lets you pick a drawing of a tow truck and color it your way. Choose shades for the cab, towing equipment and other parts of the picture. Try colors that match across the drawing or make the different parts stand out. Switch trucks when you want another picture to work on.

pages.title: Press to Push
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Press to Push gives you green blocks and holes to guide them into. Activate the pushers with the buttons and work out which one needs to move first. A push changes the layout for the next move, so look at where the block will stop before pressing again. There are 46 puzzles to solve.

pages.title: Classic Slide Puzzle
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Classic Slide Puzzle gives you numbered tiles arranged out of order. Slide a tile into the empty space to change the layout, then work toward getting all the numbers in sequence. Think ahead about where the gap will end up after each move. Finish the arrangement as quickly as you can.

pages.title: Koala Bear
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Koala Bear challenges you to keep a sleeping koala away from moving hazards. Guide it toward stars to earn points and keep it clear of objects that will wake it up and end the attempt. The game gets faster over time, so look ahead as you decide whether it is safe to go after the next star.

pages.title: Princess Of Pets Coloring
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Of Pets Coloring gives you pictures of royal pets to color. Pick a picture and use the mouse to apply the colors you choose. You can make the animal's markings stand out, give the picture a matching palette or try a different look. Choose another pet when you want a new drawing.

pages.title: Battleship
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Battleship puts your fleet against a computer opponent. Guess where enemy ships are hidden and use the results of each shot to narrow down the next target. There are three computer opponents to choose from, and special abilities can help locate ships. Find the opposing fleet before the computer finds yours.

pages.title: Cook Chinese Food Asian Cooking
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Cook Chinese Food Asian Cooking gives you a virtual kitchen and orders to prepare. Work through dishes such as fried noodles, dim sum and spring rolls. The menu also includes fortune cookies and sweet dumplings. Follow the cooking steps for each order, then finish the meal before moving on to a different dish.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Planets
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Planets replaces the usual bubbles with planets. Aim and launch each planet so it joins others of the same kind. Look for matches that clear space for a later shot, and use power-ups to get through difficult parts of the board. Watch which planet is ready before choosing where to fire.

pages.title: ZigZag Taxi
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: ZigZag Taxi asks you to build bridges between platforms so a taxi can reach the finish. Press and hold to extend the road, then release when it is long enough to meet the next platform. Judge the gap before each build so the taxi has a path across. There are more than 100 levels to try.

pages.title: AirShoot Wars
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: AirShoot Wars gives you a ship to pilot against a fleet of enemies. Choose which craft to fly, then move through the area and shoot at the opposing ships. The available ships are open from the start, so you can try another one before going back into battle. The goal is to destroy the enemy fleet.

pages.title: Match The Shapes
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Match The Shapes challenges you to make your shapes match the ones coming toward them. Touch the left or right side of the screen to change the shape on that side, or use the arrow keys on a keyboard. Watch both sides as the next shapes approach. A collision with the wrong shape ends the run.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Gingerbread Man Coloring offers eight pictures and a palette of 23 colors. Pick a drawing and apply your chosen shades to its details. Finishing quickly can improve your score, or you can take your time trying different colors. Save the finished image if you want to keep a copy of your work.

pages.title: Santa Gift Race
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Santa Gift Race sends Santa to collect presents on a motorbike. Use the arrow keys or the on-screen controls to ride and balance the bike. Watch where the next gifts are as you cross the course, and pick up as many as you can without losing control. Help Santa build up a load of presents for the children.

pages.title: Roller Magnet
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Roller Magnet lets you steer a magnet through an area filled with blocks and cubes. Use the arrow keys to move close enough to attract the pieces and draw them in. Avoid the bombs as you go. Pay attention to what lies between the magnet and the next group you want to collect.

pages.title: Fish Master
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Fish Master lets you guide a fishing hook with the mouse. Move it toward the fish you want to catch and look for larger ones as well as smaller fish. Take your catch into account when deciding what to improve. The game offers hook and speed upgrades that change your options on later trips.

pages.title: Hallowen Parkour
pages.creator: juegocaca.com
pages.description: Hallowen Parkour is a 3D course where you jump between platforms. Line up each jump, get across the gap and prepare for the next one once you land. Look at the distance to the next platform before moving. The aim is to reach the end of the course without falling.

pages.title: Scary Halloween Differences
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Scary Halloween Differences gives you two Halloween pictures with seven changes to find. Compare the same areas of both pictures and mark the details that differ. Each of the ten levels gives you one minute, so keep moving through the scene when a particular change is hard to spot.

pages.title: Air Force 2018
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Air Force 2018 puts you at the controls of an F117. Fly into enemy formations and shoot at the aircraft in your way. Look for ammunition, fuel and hearts to replenish your supplies during the flight. Keep watching what is ahead as you decide when to attack and when to go after a pickup.

pages.title: Knife Spin
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Knife Spin gives you a moving board to hit with thrown knives. Watch its motion before you take each shot and time the throw so the knife reaches the board. As you work through later levels, use what you learned from the previous throws to judge the next opening.

pages.title: Porsche Taycan Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Porsche Taycan Puzzle lets you rebuild six pictures of the Porsche Taycan. Choose an image and a piece count of 16, 36, 64 or 100. Look for pieces that share a line of bodywork or part of the background, then fit them into the picture. Try a larger layout when you want more pieces to sort.

pages.title: Classical Deer Sniper Hunting 2019
pages.creator: TechionicsInc
pages.description: Classical Deer Sniper Hunting 2019 gives you a sniper rifle for deer hunting missions. Use the right mouse button to zoom and the left to shoot. Follow the deer as they move and wait for a clear view before firing. Other animals share the area, so the game asks you to identify the deer and leave the rest alone.

pages.title: Real Dog Racing Simulator 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Real Dog Racing Simulator 3D lets you choose a dog and take it onto the track. Use WASD or the arrow keys to control the dog as you race. Try Arcade, Endless or Knockout mode for a different kind of event. The selection options also let you change the dog's color and choose a level before you start.

pages.title: Zuma Boom
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Zuma Boom gives you a moving chain of colored marbles. Aim at the chain and make groups of three or more of the same color to clear them. A match can bring other colors together and set off a chain reaction for bonus points. Keep breaking up the line before it reaches the hole.

pages.title: American Cars Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: American Cars Differences gives you two pictures of an American car with seven details changed. Compare the matching parts of the pictures and mark each difference you find. You have one minute to finish each of ten levels, so scan the car and its surroundings before spending too much time on one detail.

pages.title: Space Astro
pages.creator: Noobzilla
pages.description: Space Astro sends you into space to rescue stranded astronauts. Guide your craft toward each astronaut and keep away from the asteroids in the way. Look at where the rocks are before making your approach. The challenge is to get close enough for the rescue without hitting an obstacle on the way.

pages.title: Physics Knife
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Physics Knife gives you a knife, axe or shuriken to throw at a red target. Experiment with the throw and watch how the weapon flips or bounces before it lands. Those moves can add to your score, so you can try a more involved shot once you have the aim worked out. Compare your throws with your best result.

pages.title: First Date Love Cupcake
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: First Date Love Cupcake lets you make a cupcake as a gift for a first date. Choose how the cake looks from the base to the toppings. Try combinations that suit the person it is for, and adjust the decoration until the finished cupcake looks the way you want.

pages.title: EG Ranger Zombies
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Ranger Zombies follows a ranger fighting zombies on the ground and in the air. Use the shotgun and special attacks including fire, lightning and ice. Gather items, improvements and coins as you go. Watch both directions of attack before deciding how to use the next shot or ability.

pages.title: Kingdom Tower Defense
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Kingdom Tower Defense asks you to build defenses against waves of enemies. Use the mouse to place towers at the available positions, then watch which parts of the route are under the most pressure. Upgrade your towers as the waves continue and add more where the enemy is getting through. The levels give you new layouts to defend.

pages.title: Photo Escapes
pages.creator: oneru220
pages.description: Photo Escapes is a first-person horror game set in an asylum. Explore the building and look for a way out while keeping your camera with you. Use WASD to move and Q to open or close doors. Press E to bring out the camera, then use F or the left mouse button to take a picture. Keep watching your surroundings as you search from room to room.

pages.title: Speed Box
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Speed Box gives you a moving box and a course full of obstacles and items to collect. Turn from side to side and use the surfaces around the course to find a route past hazards. Pick up items as you go to build speed and advance. Look ahead before turning so you have room to dodge what comes next.

pages.title: Color Bump 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Color Bump 3D asks you to move through courses filled with colored obstacles. Drag left or right to steer, pushing through pieces you can touch and keeping clear of the other colors. Look ahead at which gaps will stay open when the pieces move. Each level gives you another layout to get through.

pages.title: Fruit Master Online
pages.creator: Plonga.com
pages.description: Fruit Master Online asks you to time knife throws at moving fruit. Wait for a shot that can slice through several pieces, then keep cutting until the fruit is ready to turn into juice. Visit the shop to buy new knives and take them into later rounds. The timing of the throw is the main challenge.

pages.title: Hunter 3D
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Hunter 3D is a shooting game where animals move across the hunting area. Click and hold to aim at a target, then release to fire when you have a clear shot. Follow the animal's movement before releasing. The challenge is deciding when to wait and when to take the shot.

pages.title: 12Numbers
pages.creator: Dreamly Games
pages.description: 12Numbers tests whether you can remember a sequence of twelve numbers. Watch which numbers appear and pay attention to their order. Then repeat the sequence as accurately as you can. See how far through the list you can recall it, and try another round to improve your best score.

pages.title: Princess back to School
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess back to School gets the princesses ready for their first day after summer break. Browse the wardrobe and choose a school outfit for each one. Try different pieces together to see what fits the look you want. Give the princesses coordinated outfits or make each choice a little different.

pages.title: Idle Miners
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Idle Miners puts you in charge of a mining company after your father goes missing. Tap to get the business started and use the money from mining carts to buy upgrades. Open new mines as the company grows. The mining operation is part of a two-part story about taking over the business and finding out what happened to him.

pages.title: Princess Met Gala 2018
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Met Gala 2018 has you prepare Rapunzel, Ariel, Elsa and Moana for the Met Gala red carpet. Choose the pieces for each princess's look and see how they work together. Try different styles across the four characters as you get them ready for the evening's fundraising ball.

pages.title: Endless Neon
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Endless Neon collects five arcade games with a neon look. Switch between challenges such as a brick breaker, a runner and a paddle game. Each mode gets harder the longer you play and keeps a score of its own. The collection also tracks a combined total, so you can improve it by revisiting any of the five games.

pages.title: Selfie Queen Instagram Diva
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Selfie Queen Instagram Diva follows a princess preparing pictures for her new Instagram profile. Do her makeup and choose an outfit before the photo session. Try combinations of clothes and makeup that work together on camera. Once the styling is ready, she can take photos to post on her in-game profile.

pages.title: Editors Pick Night Out
pages.creator: GAMEGOS
pages.description: Editors Pick Night Out gives you a wardrobe to browse while Alice gets ready to go out with her friends. Try clothing combinations and see which one fits the look you want for her evening. Change pieces as you go, then settle on an outfit before she leaves for the night.

pages.title: Playful Kitty Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Playful Kitty Game asks you to get a ball of wool to a waiting cat. Click breakable pieces to remove them, then watch the remaining objects fall and change the ball's path. Each of the 24 puzzles has up to three coins to collect. Choose what to break so the wool reaches the cat.

pages.title: Holiday Makeover Show
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Holiday Makeover Show puts you in charge of a salon preparing a winter party look. Bring the character into the spa for a makeover, then choose from the winter makeup options. Try different colors to create the style you want for the Christmas party, and finish the look before she heads out.
